research_question: With cognition, model, adapter, decoding, seed, prompt allocation and cases fixed, does replacing only the neutral surface policy with the structured target public-persona policy produce usable fresh local-model replies and observable policy sensitivity?
falsifiable_hypothesis: At least three of five pairs will yield strict-valid replies in both conditions, and at least one such pair will differ after normalization, while allocated compute schedules remain equal and no legacy fixed surface is accessed.
controls: same base model and adapter loaded once
same open-ended case and cognitive plan within each pair
empty production memory and reset transient rightbrain history per generation
no repair call and exactly one candidate per condition

failure_interpretation.compute_parity_failure: The comparison is confounded and no policy result may be interpreted.
failure_interpretation.insufficient_strict_valid_pairs: The current local model or surface contract cannot carry the policy reliably enough for blind comparison.
failure_interpretation.no_output_difference: The provider is structurally present but has no observable effect in this pilot.
failure_interpretation.pass: Only a blinded policy-direction coding bundle is authorized; target-person similarity is still unknown.
